patch_list: Character editor
Edit your hero's stats, talents, subclass, armor ability, modifiers, resistances and status effects.
Enemy editor
Edit any creature's health, side, behavior and status effects.
Floor editor
Edit the tiles, traps, plants, area effects, items and creatures on the current floor, and draw the floor by dragging.
Fun
Just for fun: change your hero's sprite to another hero, an enemy or an NPC.
Hunger editor
Change how long each hunger stage lasts and how starving hurts, or switch hunger off.
Inventory editor
Edit gold, energy and every item, add any item, and identify or uncurse everything. Adds unlimited inventory space and Equipment and Rings backpack tabs.

Save management
Export and import all saves as a zip, keep up to 10 saves of each game, and Undo / Redo. Optional public, uncompressed save files.
